teaser: A blueprint, unrolled before the ink is dry. Life path 4 builds, and INTJ designs before it builds, so this reading is about what happens when those two stages collide instead of taking turns. You are a 4, laying one stone after another toward something that holds, and an INTJ, already seeing the finished structure before the first stone is set. The crossing isn't two speeds fighting for the wheel so much as two phases of the same project, arriving in the wrong order half the time. Plans get redrawn at the foundation stage. The ground keeps asking what the mind already finished.
